description: Search the public LinkedIn Ad Library, scrape specific ads, or count matches. Every keyword, advertiser, payer, and company-ID group becomes its own search; country, date, sort, impression, and targeting filters apply to all searches.

adIds.description: Numeric ad IDs or linkedin.com/ad-library/detail/... URLs. Used by mode adDetails.
adIds.title: Ad IDs or Detail URLs

advertiserMatch.description: Client-side precision for advertiser-name searches. Exact company IDs are never filtered. 'Starts with' removes partner-noise results while keeping names such as 'Microsoft in Business'.
advertiserMatch.title: Advertiser Name Match

advertisers.description: Advertiser names (fuzzy accountOwner search) or LinkedIn company URLs. Each name is an independent search. Use companyIds for exact matching.
advertisers.title: Advertisers

companyIds.description: Exact numeric LinkedIn company IDs (for example, Microsoft is 1035). Multiple IDs are OR-ed in one exact search. Company URLs are accepted too.
companyIds.title: LinkedIn Company IDs

companyUrls.description: LinkedIn company page URLs. The actor resolves each public page to its numeric organization ID and searches it exactly.
companyUrls.title: Company URLs

countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 delivery country codes (US, GB, DE, ...) or ALL. Multiple codes are sent in one comma-separated filter.
countries.title: Countries

dateOption.description: LinkedIn's date window. Use custom-date-range with startDate/endDate for an exact period (maximum 12 months back).
dateOption.title: Date Range

decodeShortLinks.description: Resolve lnkd.in and similar short links to their final landing URL. Adds one request per short link.
decodeShortLinks.title: Decode Short Links

directUrls.description: Pasted Ad Library search URLs, ad detail URLs, or LinkedIn company page URLs. Search filters are preserved.
directUrls.title: Direct URLs

endDate.description: End of a custom range (YYYY-MM-DD). Required when dateOption is custom-date-range.
endDate.title: End Date

impressionsMaxUnit.description: Unit for the maximum impression value.
impressionsMaxUnit.title: Maximum Impressions Unit

impressionsMaxValue.description: Upper bound of the impression range (EU transparency data only). Required together with the minimum value.
impressionsMaxValue.title: Maximum Impressions Value

impressionsMinUnit.description: Unit for the minimum impression value.
impressionsMinUnit.title: Minimum Impressions Unit

impressionsMinValue.description: Lower bound of the impression range (EU transparency data only). LinkedIn requires both a minimum and a maximum value.
impressionsMinValue.title: Minimum Impressions Value

includeDetails.description: Open each ad's detail page for full copy, CTA, landing URL, video, payer, and EU transparency data. Adds one request per ad.
includeDetails.title: Include Detail Pages

maxItems.description: Global cap on ads returned across all searches (1-4800). Each search can return at most 4,800 ads (200 pages of 24).
maxItems.title: Maximum Records

mode.description: What to collect: search the library, open specific ads, process pasted URLs, or count matches only.
mode.title: Mode

payer.description: Search ads by the legal entity that paid for them, e.g. 'Microsoft Corporation'. Each payer is an independent search.
payer.title: Paid for by (payer)

searchTerms.description: One or more keyword searches, e.g. 'AI' or 'cloud computing'. Each keyword is an independent search (union), not a combination.
searchTerms.title: Keywords

startDate.description: Start of a custom range (YYYY-MM-DD). Required when dateOption is custom-date-range.
startDate.title: Start Date

targetingExcluded.description: Filters ads that exclude any of these categories (EU transparency data only). Values: LANGUAGE, LOCATION, AUDIENCE, DEMOGRAPHIC, COMPANY, EDUCATION, JOB, INTERESTS_AND_TRAITS.
targetingExcluded.title: Excluded Targeting Facets

targetingIncluded.description: Filters ads that target any of these categories (EU transparency data only). Values: LANGUAGE, LOCATION, AUDIENCE, DEMOGRAPHIC, COMPANY, EDUCATION, JOB, INTERESTS_AND_TRAITS.
targetingIncluded.title: Included Targeting Facets

title: LinkedIn Ad Library Scraper Input
